foodNutrients.footnote: 1,3:1,6 beta-glucans were determined with the Megazyme Mushroom and Yeast Test Kit (K-YBGL), using sulfuric acid for hydrolysis. The method involves quantification of glucose in acid-hydrolyzed samples after enzymatic digestion with exo-1,3-beta-glucanase and beta-glucosidase and subtraction of the contribution of glucose from alpha-glucans, free sucrose and glucose, as reported by McCleary and Draga (J AOAC Int. 2016 Mar-Apr;99(2):364-73). In this release, data for beta-glucan in mushrooms, except Agaricus bisporus (white button, crimini, portabella) have been replaced with results from analysis using the updated protocol which has trehalase enzyme added to the protocol, addressing potential overestimation of β-glucan content in samples containing trehalose (K-YBGL, 08/23. Previously K-YBGL, 11/19). Values for Agaricus mushrooms were not updated due to low levels of beta-glucan and no difference beyond analytical uncertainty resulting from the modified procedure.
foodNutrients.footnoteZh: 1,3:1,6-β-葡聚糖采用Megazyme蘑菇和酵母检测试剂盒（K-YBGL）测定，并使用硫酸水解。该方法先以外切-1,3-β-葡聚糖酶和β-葡萄糖苷酶进行酶解，再定量酸水解样品中的葡萄糖，并扣除α-葡聚糖、游离蔗糖和葡萄糖的贡献，方法参见McCleary和Draga（J AOAC Int. 2016 Mar-Apr;99(2):364-73）。本版本中，除双孢蘑菇（白蘑菇、褐蘑菇和大褐菇）外，其余蘑菇的β-葡聚糖数据已替换为采用更新方案所得的分析结果；更新方案加入海藻糖酶，以解决含海藻糖样品中β-葡聚糖可能被高估的问题（K-YBGL，08/23；此前为K-YBGL，11/19）。由于双孢蘑菇的β-葡聚糖含量较低，且改进方法带来的差异未超出分析不确定性，因此其数值未更新。

foodNutrients.footnote: 1,3:1,6 beta-glucans were determined with the Megazyme Mushroom and Yeast Test Kit (K-YBGL), using sulfuric acid for hydrolysis. The method involves quantification of glucose in acid-hydrolyzed samples after enzymatic digestion with exo-1,3-beta-glucanase and beta-glucosidase and subtraction of the contribution of glucose from alpha-glucans, free sucrose and glucose, as reported by McCleary and Draga (J AOAC Int. 2016 Mar-Apr;99(2):364-73). Results should be interpreted based on the assumptions inherent in the methodology, as well as the measurement uncertainty for individual samples (Percent relative standard deviation for sample replicates: 0.0-35.4, mean 9.1, median 6.5, n=24). Update: A product notification update reports that the inclusion of the enzyme trehalase in the Megazyme beta-glucan assay kit causes an overestimation in samples that contain trehalose.
foodNutrients.footnoteZh: 1,3:1,6-β-葡聚糖采用Megazyme蘑菇和酵母检测试剂盒（K-YBGL）测定，并使用硫酸水解。该方法先以外切-1,3-β-葡聚糖酶和β-葡萄糖苷酶进行酶解，再定量酸水解样品中的葡萄糖，并扣除α-葡聚糖、游离蔗糖和葡萄糖的贡献，方法参见McCleary和Draga（J AOAC Int. 2016 Mar-Apr;99(2):364-73）。结果解读应同时考虑方法本身的假设和单个样品的测量不确定性（样品重复测定的相对标准偏差：0.0%～35.4%，平均值9.1，中位数6.5，n=24）。更新说明：产品通知指出，在Megazyme β-葡聚糖测定试剂盒中加入海藻糖酶，会使含海藻糖样品的测定结果出现高估。

foodNutrients.footnote: 1,3:1,6 beta-glucans were determined with the Megazyme Mushroom and Yeast Test Kit (K-YBGL), using sulfuric acid for hydrolysis. The method involves quantification of glucose in acid-hydrolyzed samples after enzymatic digestion with exo-1,3-beta-glucanase and beta-glucosidase and subtraction of the contribution of glucose from alpha-glucans, free sucrose and glucose, as reported by McCleary and Draga (J AOAC Int. 2016 Mar-Apr;99(2):364-73). Results should be interpreted based on the assumptions inherent in the methodology, as well as the measurement uncertainty for individual samples (Percent relative standard deviation for sample replicates: 0.0-35.4, mean 9.1, median 6.5, n=24). Update: A product notification update reports that the inclusion of the enzyme trehalase in the Megazyme beta-glucan assay kit causes an overestimation in samples that contain trehalose.
foodNutrients.footnoteZh: 1,3:1,6-β-葡聚糖采用Megazyme蘑菇和酵母检测试剂盒（K-YBGL）测定，并使用硫酸水解。该方法先以外切-1,3-β-葡聚糖酶和β-葡萄糖苷酶进行酶解，再定量酸水解样品中的葡萄糖，并扣除α-葡聚糖、游离蔗糖和葡萄糖的贡献，方法参见McCleary和Draga（J AOAC Int. 2016 Mar-Apr;99(2):364-73）。结果解读应同时考虑方法本身的假设和单个样品的测量不确定性（样品重复测定的相对标准偏差：0.0%～35.4%，平均值9.1，中位数6.5，n=24）。更新说明：产品通知指出，在Megazyme β-葡聚糖测定试剂盒中加入海藻糖酶，会使含海藻糖样品的测定结果出现高估。

foodNutrients.footnote: 1,3:1,6 beta-glucans were determined with the Megazyme Mushroom and Yeast Test Kit (K-YBGL), using sulfuric acid for hydrolysis. The method involves quantification of glucose in acid-hydrolyzed samples after enzymatic digestion with exo-1,3-beta-glucanase and beta-glucosidase and subtraction of the contribution of glucose from alpha-glucans, free sucrose and glucose, as reported by McCleary and Draga (J AOAC Int. 2016 Mar-Apr;99(2):364-73). In this release, data for beta-glucan in mushrooms, except Agaricus bisporus (white button, crimini, portabella) have been replaced with results from analysis using the updated protocol which has trehalase enzyme added to the protocol, addressing potential overestimation of β-glucan content in samples containing trehalose (K-YBGL, 08/23. Previously K-YBGL, 11/19). Values for Agaricus mushrooms were not updated due to low levels of beta-glucan and no difference beyond analytical uncertainty resulting from the modified procedure.
foodNutrients.footnoteZh: 1,3:1,6-β-葡聚糖采用Megazyme蘑菇和酵母检测试剂盒（K-YBGL）测定，并使用硫酸水解。该方法先以外切-1,3-β-葡聚糖酶和β-葡萄糖苷酶进行酶解，再定量酸水解样品中的葡萄糖，并扣除α-葡聚糖、游离蔗糖和葡萄糖的贡献，方法参见McCleary和Draga（J AOAC Int. 2016 Mar-Apr;99(2):364-73）。本版本中，除双孢蘑菇（白蘑菇、褐蘑菇和大褐菇）外，其余蘑菇的β-葡聚糖数据已替换为采用更新方案所得的分析结果；更新方案加入海藻糖酶，以解决含海藻糖样品中β-葡聚糖可能被高估的问题（K-YBGL，08/23；此前为K-YBGL，11/19）。由于双孢蘑菇的β-葡聚糖含量较低，且改进方法带来的差异未超出分析不确定性，因此其数值未更新。
